label: Parabolic mirror (on-axis)
tooltip: On-axis front-surface parabolic mirror (concave toward -x, conic k=-1, R=2*rfl -- exact paraxial AND geometric focus at x=-rfl from the vertex, no on-axis spherical aberration): revolved exact-sag BSpline + surface_override, extractor-verified <1 um, same technique as lens_asphere. (Descoped from an off-axis OAP: the extractor's asphere vertex-locator requires the retained face to include the r~=0 vertex, which a 90-deg off-axis segment structurally never does.)
